audit_notes: C1 through C4 locate the far, dining-table-facing edge of the cleanup peninsula, not the island-facing working edge. The latter remains unsurveyed.

C1 and C2 share X = 190, making their straight far-edge segment parallel to the island appliance-to-dining edges. C1 is the counter edge beyond the family-room wall line; the wall itself remains a separate unsurveyed reference.

The straight C1→C2 cleanup/service counter is 25 in deep. Its provisional kitchen-facing working-edge line is therefore X = 165 when its far edge is X = 190; this is a calculated inference, not a separately captured coordinate.

C3 and C4 share Y = 177, placing the far edge 1 in dining-side of the raised guest-perch front at Y = 176. This near coincidence is preserved as captured; counter depth and the perch's exact relationship remain separately unsurveyed.

W1 = (177, 215) is the nominal wall corner on the far side of the family-room-to-dining walkway. Its current coordinate relationship to C3 computes to about 49 in, but a direct field measurement is about 54 in. Preserve the direct measurement and treat W1's coordinate as approximate until its X or Y value is reconciled.
Island range-edge X coordinate minus range-front X coordinate is 33.5 in; consistent with the separately measured 34 in clearance.
Guest-perch Y = 176 and table-near-edge Y = 258 imply 82 in, versus separately measured 84 in. Preserve both until field verification resolves the 2 in difference.
T2.X minus T1.X is 66 in, versus previously reported 67 in table length. Preserve both until field verification resolves the 1 in difference.

active_concept_study_reclaim_the_diagona.status: Provisional design test only; not existing-condition geometry, not a locked design, and not usable for construction or 3D-model coordinates.
active_concept_study_reclaim_the_diagona.intent: Reclaim the footprint of the current diagonal family-room passageway for a straighter cleanup/service row while preserving an intelligible dining-table-to-inner-kitchen route.
active_concept_study_reclaim_the_diagona.range_assumption: Hold existing range location for this test because exhaust constraints make a range relocation high-friction.

cleanup_row_test.proposed_extension: Straighten and modestly lengthen the row into the current diagonal footprint; keep its lower termination outboard of the dining-table approach. Exact endpoint is unsurveyed.

flipped_peninsula_test.note: Guest layer remains distinct from island seating. Island size and final program are not decided by this test.
